hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook that configures asymmetric static LP fees per pool (separate rates for clanker-token and paired-token swap directions), collects a 20% protocol fee on paired-token flows via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta manipulation, and includes a temporary MEV protection module active for 2 minutes post-deployment that can increase fees to deter sandwich attacks.
